list.title: Sources
list.empty: No sources yet. Add one below.

add.title: Add a source
add.citationHelp: Short, like “VMLS”. It's shown in citations.
add.author: Author (optional)
add.textHelp: Paste text here, or upload a file. LaTeX in $…$ and $$…$$ stays as written.
add.typed: Typed or pasted text, or a .md or .txt file
add.chapterTitles: Each chapter's source is named after the chapter.

preview.title: Preview
preview.summary: {{sections}} sections, {{chunks}} chunks, about {{tokens}} tokens. Nothing has been saved yet.

warnings.no_headings: This text has no headings, so it will be one section.
warnings.duplicate_heading: More than one heading is called “{{heading}}”.
warnings.unit_too_large: A block in “{{heading}}” is about {{tokens}} tokens and can't be split. Saving will fail until it's shorter.
warnings.figures_dropped: {{count}} figures or images were left out. Only the text and equations are kept.
warnings.low_text: Very little text was found. The pages may be scans that couldn't be read.
warnings.unbalanced_math: An equation is missing its closing dollar sign. Check the equations before saving.
warnings.pages_skipped: {{count}} pages of the PDF weren't read.
warnings.math_unparsed: Some equations couldn't be displayed. Check them before saving.

revisions.title: Revisions
revisions.help: Saving makes a new revision. Earlier ones stay, so published citations keep working.

scope.title: Scope
scope.help: Pick the sections to use. Ticking a heading includes everything under it.
scope.label: Sections
scope.tooLarge: too large for one call, so it's split across calls

viewer.title: Passages
viewer.empty: No passages in the selected sections.

flagged.title: Flagged passages
flagged.help: A program written from these passages tried something the sandbox denied. Check them for instructions aimed at the model. Nothing has been removed.

delete.title: Delete this source?
delete.body: It leaves your library. Tests already published from it keep their citations.

pdf.pagesHelp: Applies to the PDFs you choose next: for example 5-23, or 1,4,9-12. Leave empty to read every page: a whole book works, read 20 pages at a time.
pdf.resultTitle: What was read from the PDF
pdf.added: {{count}} PDFs added. They're read in the background and appear in the list below.
pdf.summary: {{name}}: {{pages}} pages read, {{sections}} sections, {{characters}} characters. The text stays on the server; the source is made there.
pdf.makeWhole: One source of the whole PDF
pdf.noOutline: This PDF has no bookmarks, so it's made into one source; its headings become the sections.

uploads.title: PDFs
uploads.help: Add PDFs here. They're read in the background, so you can leave this page; when one is read, make a source from it in the form below.
uploads.caption: {{count}} PDFs
uploads.ready: Read: {{pages}} pages. Ready to check and save.
uploads.readyAnnounce: Finished reading {{name}}. It's in the PDFs list, ready to continue.
uploads.removeHelp: It leaves this list and won't be read or saved. Sources already made from it keep it.
uploads.empty: No PDFs waiting. Ones you add appear here until they're made into sources.
uploads.madeSource: The text read from {{name}} is in the form below. Check it, name the source and save.

savedMany: {{count}} sources made, one per chapter. They're in the list above, embedding.
